facts.fact: The ICTC director general said a government programme registers ICT start-ups (over 400 registered, 161 qualified) and labels them in tanzanite, gold and silver tiers, with the first labelled batch to be published in February 2026.
facts.system: ICTC start-up registration and tiered labelling programme

facts.fact: The ICTC director general said more than 95 innovation hubs had been established nationwide by the end of 2025, with no cohort programme described for them.
